description: do_deliver checks MTA-STS enforcement against all recipient domains (deduplicated) before opening the TCP connection. A contributor might suggest moving the check after connection to avoid the extra latency on the fast path. That would be wrong: RFC 8461 §4 requires enforcement to prevent delivery to non-compliant relays; the connection itself is the act of delivery. Moving the check post-connect would also require a partial-connection teardown path, adding complexity. The current design is simpler and more correct.
title: MTA-STS enforcement before TCP connect, not after: pre-connect domain check design
